'''Bana Breemu''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented the [[Humbarine sector/Legends|Humbarine sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She also was part of the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]]<ref name="LoE" /> and the [[Delegation of 2000]].<ref name="DB" />

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Amidala|I know a Jedi I feel we should consult.|Breemu|That would be dangerous.|Mothma|We don't know how the Jedi fit into all this.|attr=Padmé Amidala, Bana Breemu and Mon Mothma|audio=HowDoJediFit.flac|src=<ref name="Episode III" />}}
Due to their importance as industrious [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Humbarine sector/Legends|Humbarine sector]] became targets of heavy [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] attacks during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Worlds that were not sundered, were often infiltrated by Separatist forces, and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Breemu soon felt the effects. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] deemed her besieged [[Sector/Legends|sector]] a lost cause, and Breemu found her political voice slipping in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]].<ref name="DB" /> Following the [[Bombardment of Humbarine/Legends|destruction]] of [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]] itself, she befriended one of her constituents who had escaped, [[Barrow Oicunn/Legends|Barrow Oicunn]].<ref name="DB2">{{DB|character|ltoicunn|Oicunn, Lieutenant}}</ref>

She remained a trusted and valued member of the Republic, serving as a member of the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] by the end of the Clone Wars,<ref name="LoE" /> and was invited to join the [[Delegation of 2000]] in the final days of the war. While Senators such as [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] wanted to force the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] to give up his wartime emergency powers, Bana advised caution. She also recommended that involving the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in their plans was risky, instead wishing for a diplomatic solution to the problem. Breemu was one of the Senators who presented the [[Petition of 2000]] to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}} {{C|deleted scenes}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Bana Breemu was played by [[Bai Ling]] in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the last installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].<ref name="Episode III" /> Her scenes, however, were deleted from the film's final cut. Ling claimed that it was the result of her posing in the June [[2005]] issue of [[Wikipedia:Playboy|''Playboy'']], but director [[George Lucas]] insisted that the cuts were made nearly a year prior to her posing for the magazine. Her scenes were later featured in the "Deleted Scenes" category on the ''Revenge of the Sith'' DVD. On the DVD commentary, Lucas reiterated his claim, saying her scenes were deleted for length.<ref name="Episode III DVD Commentary">{{Film|III}} DVD commentary</ref>
